policy_name: Review evidence readable by KPI participants
using_expr:
((bucket_id = 'review-evidence'::text) AND ((storage.foldername(name))[2] ~ '^[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}$'::text) AND (((storage.foldername(name))[3] IS NULL) OR ((storage.foldername(name))[3] = ANY (ARRAY['self-evidence'::text, 'reviewer-evidence'::text, 'auditor-evidence'::text, 'management-evidence'::text, 'observation-evidence'::text, 'observation-replies'::text]))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM ((kpis k
     LEFT JOIN profiles emp ON ((emp.id = k.employee_id)))
     LEFT JOIN profiles mgr ON ((mgr.id = emp.reporting_manager_id)))
  WHERE (((k.id)::text = (storage.foldername(objects.name))[2]) AND ((k.employee_id = auth.uid()) OR (emp.reporting_manager_id = auth.uid()) OR (mgr.reporting_manager_id = auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM audit_kpi_assignments a
          WHERE ((a.employee_id = k.employee_id) AND (a.auditor_id = auth.uid())))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM audit_kpi_level_assignments la
          WHERE ((la.kpi_id = k.id) AND (la.auditor_id = auth.uid())))) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM kpi_mention_access m
          WHERE ((m.kpi_id = k.id) AND (m.user_id = auth.uid())))))))))
